context.transcript:
Good evening. ®I apologize for the delay. ®We were having
some problems with the microphone. ®It's my pleasure
to present this year's Community Excellence Award to
Mary Kebede. ®Ms. Kebede's tireless fund-raising made it
possible to purchase 5,000 trees to plant throughout our city.
Trees are essential because they improve air quality and cool
the environment. But most importantly, studies have shown
that they reduce the symptoms of stress in city residents. So,
on behalf of the community, thank you, Ms. Kebede.
Kebede dh.
